Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 85. Category: form. Super Saiyan.

Transformation
The Saiyan’s hair lengthens to their waist and they
take on a more Neanderthal look, their foreheads
protrude and they lose their eyebrows, and lightning is
almost always sparking around them slightly. When a
Saiyan takes this form for the first time the world itself
seems to take heed, the clouds in the sky will culminate
above you, and lightning strikes occasionally.
Increase your Power by 3
You deal an additional 1d8 to damage
Increase your Movement Speed by 35
At the end of your turn, you lose 3 Stamina
Gohan Super Saiyan 2
Brusselthesaiyan
